roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
Join a dedicated team at a leading skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN). This pivotal role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff competency by overseeing critical training programs and ensuring robust infection prevention protocols are in place. We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable professional to contribute to our commitment to excellence.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring all clinical staff are up-to-date with best practices and regulatory requirements. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff to maintain a safe and healthy environment for residents and employees.

This is an immediate opening offering a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. If you are an experienced RN passionate about staff development and infection control, we encourage you to apply today and become a vital part of our compassionate care team.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or nursing education
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care, staff development, and infection control
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity for a results-driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to make a significant impact on facility growth and community engagement. The ideal candidate will be a 'hustler' with a passion for connecting with the community and driving census.

This role offers excellent compensation for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this position. You will be instrumental in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, building strong relationships with referral sources, and enhancing the facility's presence within the local healthcare landscape. Occasional weekend work will be required to support community events and outreach initiatives.
requirements: Proven track record of driving results and achieving marketing goals
Experience in healthcare marketing, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows for flexibility while providing essential therapy services to patients in a supportive environment.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting with the implementation of treatment plans, monitoring patient progress, and ensuring a high standard of care. Your contributions will be vital in helping patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life.

If you are a compassionate and skilled PTA looking for a flexible PRN role where you can make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) in Florida
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience.
